		try (BufferedWriter guardaClientesTXT = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(ficheroClientes))) {
			for (Reserva re : this.tReservas) {
				guardaClientesTXT.write(re.getCliente().getNombre());
				guardaClientesTXT.newLine();
			}
		} catch (IOException e) {
			// TODO Auto-generated catch block
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
